# DevTestudinidae Technical Knowledge Base

> Curated technical guides, hardware troubleshooting, automation workflows, and browser-based developer utilities by DevTestudinidae.

## About
- [About DevTestudinidae](https://saramjh.github.io/about/): Author identity, editorial scope, GitHub profile, and contact information for this technical knowledge base.

## Developer projects and public evidence
- [Selected developer projects](https://saramjh.github.io/portfolio/): First-party case studies with implementation context and links to documented outcomes.
- [External evidence archive](https://saramjh.github.io/portfolio/recognition/): External writing, resource listings and catalogue records, each classified by the available source.
- [Space Atlas engineering case](https://saramjh.github.io/portfolio/space-atlas/): Interactive astronomy learning models and their implementation choices.
- [KoreAves engineering case](https://saramjh.github.io/portfolio/koreaves/): Evidence-linked English/Korean birding reference for Korean species.
- [Spoonie engineering case](https://saramjh.github.io/portfolio/spoonie/): Recipe-sharing product development and implemented interaction details.
- [EUSci astronomy essay and development note (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/space-atlas-eusci-diagrams-en/): Credited external science article on missing information in astronomy diagrams, linked to Space Atlas models.
- [EUSci 기고와 개발 기록 (한국어)](https://saramjh.github.io/space-atlas-eusci-diagrams-ko/): 위 기고문의 출처 및 달 위상·계절·식 모델과의 연결을 정리한 한국어판.
- [NCASE Space Atlas program listing (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/space-atlas-ncase-programs-en/): A public programs-directory entry and its recorded scope.
- [NCASE 프로그램 목록 기록 (한국어)](https://saramjh.github.io/space-atlas-ncase-programs-ko/): Space Atlas 외부 프로그램 목록 수록 사실과 확인 가능한 범위.
- [Share My Lesson Moon phases resource (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/space-atlas-share-my-lesson-en/): An author-contributed teaching resource and the related interactive model.
- [Share My Lesson 달 위상 자료 (한국어)](https://saramjh.github.io/space-atlas-share-my-lesson-ko/): 작성자 등록 자료와 Space Atlas 달 위상 모델에 관한 한국어 기록.
- [Earth seasons no-tilt classroom experiment (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/earth-seasons-no-tilt-experiment-en/): A timed globe-and-lamp comparison of Earth's 23.5° tilt with zero tilt, including a printable worksheet.
- [지구 자전축 0° 계절 실험 (한국어)](https://saramjh.github.io/earth-seasons-no-tilt-experiment-ko/): 지구본과 LED 램프로 자전축 23.5°와 0°를 비교하고 관찰 내용을 기록하는 수업 활동.
- [KoreAves credited external writing](https://saramjh.github.io/koreaves-published-contributions-en/): Source-linked bylined contributions to an external birding publication.
- [KoreAves article on the British Ornithologists' Union blog (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/koreaves-bou-when-records-become-maps-en/): The published guest article When Records Become Maps and the engineering behind tracing regional bird records to their sources.
- [영국 조류학회 BOU 기고와 KoreAves 개발 기록 (한국어)](https://saramjh.github.io/koreaves-bou-when-records-become-maps-ko/): When Records Become Maps 기고문과 지역별 조류 기록을 지도 및 원본 출처에 연결한 개발 과정을 소개한다.
- [Spoonie iPhone PWA and search-state recovery (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/spoonie-pwa-search-state-recovery-en/): A PR #47 case study about Home Screen update checks and keeping search results after returning from a recipe detail view.
- [Spoonie iPhone PWA·검색 상태 복원 (한국어)](https://saramjh.github.io/spoonie-pwa-search-state-recovery-ko/): 홈 화면 앱의 업데이트 확인과 레시피 상세 화면에서 돌아올 때 검색 결과를 유지한 PR #47 수정 기록.
- [Spoonie: intent-based RSC prefetch and retired schedules (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/spoonie-rsc-prefetch-20261119-en/): Original PRs #48–#50 document hover/keyboard-focus prefetch, touch-scroll request prevention and retirement of legacy Netlify schedules. Monthly Functions savings were not measured.
- [Spoonie RSC 사전 요청·기존 예약 함수 정리 (한국어)](https://saramjh.github.io/spoonie-rsc-prefetch-20261119-ko/): PR #48~#50에서 선택 의도에 따른 사전 요청, 터치 스크롤 요청 방지, 구형 Netlify 예약 함수 종료를 검증한 사례. 월간 Functions 절감 효과는 확인되지 않았다.

## Hardware & macOS Troubleshooting Guides
- [Epson Waste Ink Pad Reset Without Key (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/epson-waste-ink-pad-reset-without-key/): A first-hand record of L3106 waste-ink-pad maintenance and an open-source counter-reset attempt. Compatibility with the other listed printer models is unverified, and a counter reset does not replace physical pad servicing.
- [How to Reset Epson Waste Ink Counter Free on Mac/Linux/Win (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/en-epson-waste-ink-pad-reset-without-key/): English companion to the L3106 maintenance case, including model-specific compatibility checks and physical waste-ink-pad servicing cautions.
- [MacBook External Monitor Flickering Fix (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/kr-macbook-external-monitor-flickering-solution/): Troubleshooting external monitor flickering, frequency mismatch, and USB-C display handshake issues on macOS.
- [MacBook External Monitor Flickering Solution (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/macbook-external-monitor-flickering-solution/): Practical resolution for macOS external monitor signal flickering.
- [Logitech Options Infinite Loading Fix (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/kr-logi-option-infinite-loading-solution/): Resolution for persistent infinite loading screens in Logi Options+ software on macOS/Windows.
- [Logitech Options Infinite Loading Solution (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/en-logi-option-infinite-loading-solution/): Step-by-step fix for Logi Options+ launch hang.
- [KakaoTalk Shorts Autoplay Adblock Guide (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/kakaotalk-shorts-autoplay-adblock-guide/): How to disable video autoplay, short-form feed clutter, and data-draining shopping tabs in KakaoTalk.

## Automation & AI Workflows
- [유튜브 맛집 리스트를 네이버 지도에 일괄 저장하는 방법 (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/youtube-restaurant-list-naver-map-save-guide/): 유튜브 설명란·고정 댓글에서 맛집 데이터를 정리하고, 로그인된 브라우저와 Playwright CDP를 이용해 네이버 지도 저장 작업을 줄이는 실제 워크플로.
- [네이버 지도 저장 목록 일괄 정리·이동 방법 (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/naver-map-save-list-bulk-reorganize-guide/): 저장 핀·목록 관리부터 영업 요일별 폴더 구성과 브라우저 자동화까지 단계별로 정리한 실전 가이드.
- [웹 ChatGPT가 내 Mac을 직접 조작한다 — MCP (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/chatgpt-mcp-local-development-setup/): 브라우저에서 쓰는 웹 ChatGPT가 MCP를 통해 로컬 Mac의 파일, 터미널, Git, 테스트, 브라우저를 직접 다루는 실제 구성과 OAuth/Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 운영 기록.
- [ChatGPT Web App + MCP: Control Your Mac (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/en-chatgpt-mcp-local-development-setup/): Practical setup for letting the ChatGPT web app read and edit local files, run terminal commands, use Git, tests and browser automation on a Mac through cokacremote, OAuth and Cloudflare Tunnel.
- [ChatGPT 메시지 제한 vs Codex Plus 사용량 한도 (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/chatgpt-unlimited-text-vs-codex-limits/): 2026년 공식 자료 기준으로 일반 ChatGPT 텍스트 채팅과 Codex 사용량을 분리하고 Plus 모델별 예상 범위, 로컬·클라우드 공유 한도, /status 확인법을 정리합니다.
- [ChatGPT Message Limits vs Codex Usage Limits (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/en-chatgpt-unlimited-text-vs-codex-limits/): Current Plus Codex model ranges, shared local/cloud allowance, weekly-limit caveats and how those differ from ordinary ChatGPT text-chat limits.
- [AI 코딩 에이전트 세션 컨텍스트 유지 방법 (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/ai-coding-context-continuity-cokacremote/): Context window, instruction file, persistent memory를 구분하고 Git 우선권·checkpoint·on-demand recall로 세션 간 프로젝트 상태를 이어가는 실제 구조.
- [How to Keep AI Coding Agent Context Across Sessions (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/en-ai-coding-context-continuity-cokacremote/): Cross-session coding-agent continuity using persistent memory, instruction files, Git-authoritative checkpoints and optional Serena/claude-mem retrieval.
- [Impeccable 사용 후기: AI 코딩 UI 디자인에 실제로 써보니 (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/impeccable-review-ai-ui-design/): Spoonie와 Profit Scratch에 Impeccable critique/audit/detector를 실제 적용한 결과, false positive, CI gate 활용과 AI UI anti-pattern 방지의 장단점.
- [Impeccable Review 2026: Two Real AI-Coded Products (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/en-impeccable-review-ai-ui-design/): Hands-on review of Impeccable critique, deterministic UI detection, false positives, CI integration and bounded design QA across two real products.
- [n8n Workflow Automation for Beginners (Korean)](https://saramjh.github.io/n8n-workflow-for-novice/): Introduction to setting up open-source n8n workflow automation with trigger and action nodes.
- [n8n Workflow Automation for Beginners (English)](https://saramjh.github.io/en-n8n-workflow-for-novice/): Getting started with self-hosted n8n workflow automation.
- [AI-assisted Coding Harness Prompts](https://saramjh.github.io/epson-waste-ink-pad-reset-without-key/#-ai-에이전트에게-바로-복사해서-붙여넣는-프롬프트-copy--paste): Copy-paste prompt routines for automated bug-patching and device interaction via Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity.

## Web Utilities & Interactive Tools
- [Dieter Rams Style Calculator](https://saramjh.github.io/dieter-rams-style-calculator/): Minimalist web calculator inspired by Dieter Rams and Braun ET66 design principles.
- [Online Image Resizer](https://saramjh.github.io/online-image-resizer/): In-browser client-side image resizing and format conversion utility without server uploads.
- [Amazon ASIN Code Link Generator](https://saramjh.github.io/asin-code-link-generator/): Rapid ASIN extraction and clean affiliate link formatting utility.
- [Korean Rich Face Match](https://saramjh.github.io/richChecker/): Browser-based AI face match against a focused 47-person Korean rich-list sample, with Top 3 results and six facial proportions.
- [Billionaire Face Match](https://saramjh.github.io/richChecker-us/): Focused celebrity-lookalike edition comparing six facial proportions with a 100-person billionaire sample.
- [Calendar Sharing via URL](https://saramjh.github.io/calendar-sharing-via-URL/): Client-side calendar event generator and sharable URL encoder.
